in_latin.name: Beverlie
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen femininum Anglicum, significans 'flos' vel 'rosa'. Origine a 'bever' vel 'biver', significans 'flos' vel 'rosa', et 'lie', significans 'locus' vel 'situs'.
